attributes.name: Druva - UDA Correlated With Backup Failure
attributes.description: Detects resources experiencing unusual data activity and backup failures within the same observation window, potentially indicating an attack affecting recoverability.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects resources experiencing unusual data activity and backup failures within the same observation window, potentially indicating an attack affecting recoverability.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL status_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      TO_STRING(event.outcome),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.alert.name),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL feature_text =
    TO_LOWER(
      COALESCE(
        TO_STRING(druva.feature),
        ""
      )
    )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL is_uda =
    druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
    OR event_text LIKE "*unusual data activity*"

| EVAL is_backup_failure =
    (
      event_text LIKE "*backup*"
      OR feature_text LIKE "*backup*"
    )
    AND (
      status_text LIKE "*fail*"
      OR status_text LIKE "*error*"
      OR event_text LIKE "*failed*"
    )

| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      is_uda
      OR is_backup_failure
    )

| STATS
    uda_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_uda,

    backup_failure_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_backup_failure,

    first_uda =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_uda,

    first_backup_failure =
      MIN(event_time)
        WHERE is_backup_failure,

    uda_types =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.uda.type)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    uda_alert_names =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.alert.name)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    backup_failure_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE is_backup_failure,

    first_uda_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    first_failure_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_backup_failure

  BY resource

| WHERE uda_count > 0
    AND backup_failure_count > 0

| EVAL minutes_between =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_uda,
      first_backup_failure
    )
